title: Custo capability document
description: Defines what a policy capability does and how it authenticates. One document per Layer.Capability.

layer.description: Policy layer this capability runs at.

capability.description: Capability identifier (kebab-case) unique within its layer.

authMode.description: Explicit authentication mode. github-app uses the installation token; enterprise-pat uses CUSTO_ENTERPRISE_PAT for enterprise-admin endpoints the app cannot reach.

configSchema.description: Optional inline description of the config object accepted by matching policy documents.
